items.stem: Before using a BY statement in a procedure, what must usually be true of the data?

options.text: The data must be sorted by the BY variable(s)
options.rationale: Correct: BY-group processing generally requires sorted data.

options.text: The data must have no numeric variables
options.rationale: Numeric variables are fine with a BY statement.

options.text: The data must be fewer than 100 rows
options.rationale: Row count is irrelevant to the BY requirement.

options.text: The log must be turned off
options.rationale: The log should stay on to catch errors.

items.explanation: Correct: BY-group processing generally requires sorted data.

items.stem: Which TWO statements about the SAS DATA step are correct? (Select TWO.)

options.text: It iterates automatically over observations in the input
options.rationale: Correct: the implicit loop processes each observation.

options.text: It can create new variables with assignment statements
options.rationale: Correct: assignment statements compute new variables.
IF/THEN logic is a core DATA step feature.

options.text: It only reads data and never writes it
options.rationale: The DATA step both reads and writes data sets.

items.explanation: Correct: the implicit loop processes each observation.

items.stem: A MERGE produced fewer matched rows than expected. What is the most likely cause?

options.text: The data sets were not sorted by the BY variables before merging
options.rationale: Correct: unsorted input causes incorrect or dropped matches in a BY merge.
The log does not affect merge results.
PRINT only displays data; it does not merge.
Variable count does not cause match loss.

items.explanation: Correct: unsorted input causes incorrect or dropped matches in a BY merge.
